steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Sets the application name and package identifier.

steps.title: Configure Project-Level Gradle
steps.description: Sets up global build configurations, repositories, and dependencies for the entire Android project.

steps.title: Configure Module-Level Gradle
steps.description: Applies the Android plugin, defines SDK versions (min, target, compile), and specifies Java compatibility for the app module.

steps.title: Set Up AndroidManifest.xml
steps.description: Declares the application's package, components (activities), permissions, and features to the Android system. No internet permission is needed for an offline app.

steps.title: Design Main Layout (activity_main.xml)
steps.description: Creates the user interface layout for the main activity, including a TextView to display the counter value.

steps.title: Add Increment Button
steps.description: Adds a Button to the main layout that will increase the counter value when pressed.

steps.title: Add Decrement Button
steps.description: Adds a Button to the main layout that will decrease the counter value when pressed.

steps.title: Add Reset Button
steps.description: Adds a Button to the main layout that will reset the counter value to zero.

steps.title: Initialize UI Components in MainActivity
steps.description: Binds the TextView and Button objects defined in the layout XML to Java variables in MainActivity.

steps.title: Implement Increment Logic
steps.description: Adds an onClick listener to the Increment button to increase the counter and update the display.

steps.title: Implement Decrement Logic
steps.description: Adds an onClick listener to the Decrement button to decrease the counter and update the display.

steps.title: Implement Reset Logic
steps.description: Adds an onClick listener to the Reset button to set the counter to zero and update the display.

steps.title: Set up SharedPreferences for Persistence
steps.description: Initializes SharedPreferences to save and retrieve the counter value so it persists across app sessions.

steps.title: Load Counter on App Start
steps.description: Retrieves the saved counter value from SharedPreferences when MainActivity is created.

steps.title: Save Counter on Value Change
steps.description: Stores the updated counter value into SharedPreferences after each increment, decrement, or reset operation.

steps.title: Update Display
steps.description: Ensures the TextView always reflects the current state of the counter after any modification.
